project_name: Palermo – Wyandotte 115 kV Line Section Reconductoring Project
brief_description: Reconductor the Wyandotte – Pole 003/025 115 kV line section (~0.05 miles) with larger conductor and remove any limiting element.
objectives: To mitigate P0 overload on the Palermo – Wyandotte 115 kV line
driver_detail: P0 (base case) overload on a very short section (0.05 circuit miles) of the Palermo – Wyandotte 115 kV line terminating at Wyandotte substation in the near term (2022). The project scope is to reconductor the short section and remove any limiting component to achieve the full conductor capacity. Per CAISO planning rules, a P0 overload on a section where the limiting elements have lower ratings than the conductor indicates equipment capacity deficiency (equip_aging), not load growth. Alternative of 'rerrating the transmission line' was rejected, confirming a physical capacity gap.
alternatives_rejected: Rerrating the transmission line CA March 24, 2021

project_name: Manteca #1 60 kV Line Section Reconductoring Project
brief_description: Reconductor ~1.13 miles of the Manteca #1 60 kV Line with larger conductor and remove any limiting component as necessary.
objectives: To mitigate P0 overload on the Manteca #1 60 kV line
driver_detail: P0 (base case) overload on a 1.13 circuit-mile section of the Manteca #1 60 kV line between Manteca Jct. and Banta Carbona Tap in the near term (2022). Project replaces this section with higher-capacity conductor and removes any limiting components to achieve full conductor capacity. The P0 overload indicates the section is the physical bottleneck rather than a contingency-driven or load-growth issue. Note: the high-CEC sensitivity table shows additional P1/P2 overloads on this line when AAEE is removed, but the approved project is driven by the existing P0 deficiency.
alternatives_rejected: - Rerrating the transmission line 10 Mvar capacitor bank at Westley Energy storage (BESS) CA March 24, 2021

project_name: Kasson – Kasson Junction 1 115 kV Line Section Reconductoring Project
brief_description: Reconductor the Kasson – Kasson Junction 1 (~0.08 miles) 115 kV line section with larger conductor and replace structure, if necessary.
objectives: To mitigate P1 overload on the Shulte – Kasson – Manteca 115 kV line
driver_detail: P1 contingency overload on a very short section (0.08 circuit miles) of the 115 kV line between Kasson Junction 1 and Kasson 115 kV substation in the near term (2022). Project reconductors this short section with higher-capacity conductor and removes any limiting components to achieve full conductor capacity. The issue is on the Shulte – Kasson – Manteca 115 kV line, where this short section is the limiting element with a rating below the conductor's capacity. The only alternative considered was 'rerrating the transmission line', which was rejected, confirming a physical capacity gap.
